findings.title: Negative-control family 1 for packet cap/reduction is tautological
findings.evidence: The negative-control tests at tests/test_qntylab_repository_ergonomics_fitness_functions_v0.py:539 and tests/test_qntylab_repository_ergonomics_fitness_functions_v0.py:967 exercise only the literal comparison, so the negative control does not independently prove that an out-of-bounds packet would be rejected end-to-end.
findings.impact: No false PASS is created: real M1/M2 enforcement is covered by the positive test (test_c1_packet_bytes_within_hard_cap_and_reduction against live evidence, fail-closed). The defect is limited to negative-control strength for the packet-cap/reduction family.
findings.does_not_reopen_because: Medium findings do not reopen implementation unless they undermine the increment objective, invalidate verification evidence, violate a frozen invariant, or change semantics. The positive-path enforcement holds and is fail-closed; this is a negative-control-strength observation only.

findings.title: No machine cross-check of frozen_hash_manifest path-set equality vs the deletion_matrix 28 frozen rows (count-only)
findings.evidence: The fitness layer checks the frozen-row COUNT against deletion_matrix.json but does not machine-verify path-set equality between frozen_hash_manifest.json entries and the 28 DELETE_BLOCKED_BY_FROZEN_BINDING rows.
findings.impact: A path-set divergence would not be caught by an automated fitness assertion.
findings.does_not_reopen_because: Mitigated by the matrix digest binding: frozen_hash_manifest.json binds the deletion_matrix.json digest, so any matrix change would break the binding; LOW severity class deviation with a compensating control.

findings.title: acceptance_metrics.packet.no_silent_truncation has no dedicated enforcing test
findings.evidence: No fitness test asserts the no_silent_truncation acceptance metric directly.
findings.impact: That single acceptance metric is not independently enforced as a hard threshold.
findings.does_not_reopen_because: Partially covered by the overflow-control and byte-cap fitness assertions (packet bytes <= 8192 hard cap and >=95% reduction), which fail closed and would surface silent-truncation regressions in practice; LOW severity.

findings.title: Seam module project_context_execution_authority.py deliberately unbounded/unbound
findings.evidence: The DSH-execution-authority seam module qntylab/project_context_execution_authority.py is intentionally excluded from the size bound and structural binding applied to the rest of the composition root.
findings.impact: Growth of that seam module is not bounded by the C6 fitness functions.
findings.does_not_reopen_because: Documented tradeoff in the candidate evidence: the seam is the authorized DSH execution-authority boundary and binding it would entangle the fitness layer with that contract; deliberate, disclosed, and LOW.

findings.title: Authority checking covers the canonical 21-field union only; non-canonical authority-ish booleans exist on some rows outside the checked set
findings.evidence: The authority non-escalation fitness assertion evaluates the canonical registry's 21-field authority union; a small number of rows carry additional authority-ish boolean fields outside that checked set.
findings.impact: Non-canonical authority-flavored fields would not trip the fitness assertion directly.
findings.does_not_reopen_because: Canonical registry validation is the backstop: the canonical authority registry remains the machine-checked authority surface, and the extra fields are non-canonical; LOW.
